resources.string: Please add the account from the app itself.
Your Nextcloud\'s address and user name. Make an app password for this phone in Nextcloud: Settings, Security, Devices & sessions.
Your Apple Account email, and an app-specific password made for this phone at account.apple.com, under Sign-In and Security.
Your Zoho email, and an application-specific password made for this phone in your Zoho account, under Security.
The server\'s address (its name is usually enough), your user name, and a password; an app password made for this phone is best, where the server has them.
Turn on the ones to keep on this phone. Leave off any another app (DAVx5) already syncs, or they will show twice.
The server could not be reached; changes made here wait on the phone and go with the next sync. Last synced %1$s.
The server could not be reached; changes made here wait on the phone and go with the next sync.
The server refused the password. Make a new app password on the server and put it in with Change password, below.
The last sync had a problem; it tries again on the next one. Last synced %1$s.
The last sync had a problem; it tries again on the next one.
Already synced by DAVx5 on this phone. Turn it off there first, then on here.
DAVx5 also syncs a calendar by this name. If it is this one, turn it off there first, or its events will show twice.
DAVx5 also syncs an address book by this name. If it is this one, turn it off there first, or everyone in it will show twice.
Moving from DAVx5: turn a calendar off in DAVx5, then turn it on here. Everything stays on the server, and this phone fetches it again.
Moving from DAVx5: turn an address book off in DAVx5, then turn it on here. Everyone stays on the server, and this phone fetches them again.
When the server has a new app password for this phone
The server refused that password; nothing was changed.
The server could not be asked, so nothing was changed. Try again when it answers.
The server refused the password for %1$s, so nothing syncs until a new one is put in (Settings, then the server page, then Change password).
